notes: Reverse-order acrossfade of the same two forest-day creek MP3s, giving a different entry point within the 691 s loop window so variant rotation gives real variety. Same pipeline as creek-1. Seamless-looped to 691s (prime loopOffset) for native Howler looping: 6s fade-wrap of the post-loop tail over the head so the loop point is gapless.

wrapPatch.why: loopify-scenes.py never mixed the wrap crossfade tail in (afade ran before asetpts), so the loop wrapped into a fade-up from near silence every P seconds. Repaired in place: the arc around the wrap is replaced by a spectrum-matched stretch of this file with equal-power crossfades; sample count unchanged. DECISIONS.md, 'The wrap was a hole'.
